items: What You Get - 2×32-inch plant stakes and 1 roll of soft plant ties. The specially designed ties gently secure stems without leaving marks. Made of premium coated steel, these plant trellises offer exceptional durability, outperforming ordinary supports with better pressure and rust resistance

Sturdy & Reliable – This indoor plant trellis is specially designed as plant supports for indoor plants like Monstera, Pothos plant climber support, and Philodendron. It effectively organizes unruly vines using plant support stakes, guiding vertical growth to create a well-structured green space

Tool-Free Snap Assembly – Our plant stakes for indoor plants feature an innovative clip-on design for effortless setup. Even beginners can install these plant supports in just 30 seconds—no tools or complicated steps required

Expandable Design - Each set includes two 16-inch (40 cm) plant support stakes that combine into a 32-inch (80 cm) tall indoor plant trellis. Easily extend or adjust the height to suit your plant's growth stages

Universal Compatibility – Designed as versatile plant supports for indoor plants, this plant trellis indoor system fits 90% of pots. Perfect for modern homes, offices, or gardens, providing reliable pothos plant climber support and structure for all climbing varieties
